description: This file defines classes and methods for querying, processing, and transforming country profile data from EconDB, including parameter validation, data fetching, and data transformation.

classes.name: EconDbCountryProfileQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for country profile requests, including validation for country codes.

classes.name: EconDbCountryProfileData
classes.description: Represents the country profile data with alias mappings and percent normalization.

classes.name: EconDbCountryProfileFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming country profile data from EconDB asynchronously.

methods.name: validate_country
methods.description: Validates and processes country input, converting codes and groups to standard formats.

methods.name: normalize_percent
methods.description: Converts percentage values to float ratios.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms generic parameters into specific query parameter objects.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and processes data for specified countries.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw fetched data into structured country profile data objects.
